message.content:
Yes – you can file a noise‑complaint with the City of Atlanta’s local government. In the United States, “local council” usually refers to the city council, but noise complaints are typically handled by the city’s **Police Department** or **Code Enforcement** office. The council can forward the complaint to the appropriate department and may take action if the noise violates city ordinances. ### How to file a noise complaint in Atlanta | Method | What to do | Contact | |--------|------------|---------| | **Phone** | Call the Atlanta Police Department’s non‑emergency line at **404‑656‑4000**. They will log your complaint and dispatch an officer if needed. | 404‑656‑4000 | | **Online** | Use the City of Atlanta’s online portal: (or the “311” app). Select “Noise” under “Report a Problem.” | https://www.atlantaga.gov/311 | | **In‑person** | Visit the nearest police precinct or the City Hall’s Code Enforcement office. Bring any evidence (e.g., audio recordings, dates/times). | City Hall, 55 Martin Luther King Jr. Drive, Atlanta, GA 30303 | | **Mail** | Send a written complaint to:
City of Atlanta
Code Enforcement Division
55 Martin Luther King Jr. Drive, Suite 200
Atlanta, GA 30303 | 55 MLK Jr. Drive, Suite 200 | ### What information to provide 1. **Your contact details** (name, address, phone, email). 2. **Location of the noise source** (street address or intersection). 3. **Time and duration** of the disturbance. 4. **Description of the noise** (e.g., loud music, construction, barking dogs). 5. **Any evidence** (audio/video recordings, photos). ### City noise ordinance Atlanta’s noise ordinance (Title 10, Chapter 3 of the Atlanta Municipal Code) sets limits on decibel levels and defines prohibited times (typically 10 p.m.–6 a.m.). Violations can result in fines or other penalties. ### After filing - The police will investigate and may issue a warning or citation. - If the issue persists, the city council can hold a public hearing or take further action through the Code Enforcement office. ### Quick tip If you’re unsure whether the noise is a violation, you can first call the police non‑emergency line. They’ll advise whether it’s a code violation and what steps to take next. --- **Bottom line:** Yes, you can report a noise complaint to the City of Atlanta. Use the phone, online portal, or in‑person options above, and the city’s police or code enforcement will handle the investigation.
